findings.title: Diagnostic logging exceptions can alter daily results and skip rollback
findings.detail: The failure logger runs before rollback and both failure/success logging calls are unguarded. A handler exception can escape before the original result is constructed, and in the failure path can bypass rollback.
findings.requested_change: Contain logger exceptions as best-effort diagnostic I/O and ensure the failure logger cannot prevent rollback.

findings.title: Failure line can refer to a callback while module/function/hash identify the pipeline wrapper
findings.detail: The innermost traceback frame's line is recorded while module, function, and code hash are fixed to daily_pipeline.run_daily_execution_core. Exceptions raised inside ports callbacks can therefore produce a mismatched source location.
findings.requested_change: Record a normalized matching frame/module/function/hash tuple, or use a pipeline-local capture location consistently.
